title: Searching for: AI Video Generator Lifetime Deal
author: BANDOSde
selftext:
Hey everyone,
I have a few questions for you regarding "Vadoo Ai" and "Videotok" and other AI video tools. I can't decide, especially since I can barely afford one. Lifetime is the only option, since I won't be signing up for a subscription.

Let's get to my question:
Both systems work as usual, with those credits—I hate those like the plague, sorry.

I'm not interested in generating images, as I'm already well-equipped in that regard. I need an AI video generator tool that lets me create AI videos that I can later use for all sorts of things. For example, for my (mostly) instrumental tracks.

Unfortunately, it is what it is... there are so many AI tools these days that you don't even know what's good and what's bad. Especially since some people just want a lot of money, sometimes so much money that it's not worth it for me, since I don't make money with my music and have other goals in mind.

Maybe you can help me, give me a tip, or even recommend something. I would be extremely grateful if I could get an answer. I've been searching for a few months now, but I can't decide. All the AI ​​tools are great, can do everything, do it perfectly,... blah blah blah... I'd rather gather your experiences, because they're worth their weight in gold.

Thank you all in advance!
Bandos

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body: Have you just considered using veo2 for free instead? It is available in aistudio and I think Gemini app might have it too. Any lifetime deal makes no sense when the tools will get surpassed or abandoned pretty quickly.

comments.author: Superseaslug
comments.body: The only one is to build a powerful PC and do it locally. Otherwise you're paying server fees.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body:
Yes. Thank you.
Puoi ancora consigliare uno strumento video AI con Lifetime?

replies.author: Superseaslug
replies.body: Local? Use comfyUI with Wai or Hunyuan. The scene is evolving rapidly, so these may change. Fortunately, besides needing a powerful computer, it's all free.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body: I'm sorry. I don't know this Wai and Hunyuan. But it remains with a strong power computer, which I always have to have on. At least if I want to access it on the go. Not was?

replies.author: Superseaslug
replies.body: I don't think there is a single web based AI service with a lifetime membership. It doesn't make sense. It's not like a game you buy, it's immense server power they are granting you. Leaving a computer running isn't that big a deal. Just because the AI software is running doesn't mean it's drawing power. Only when you send a job.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body: Thank you! So I have to keep looking.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body:
Yea, thanks.
But i need to be online with my PC, or i only can generate offline at home and not on the road.

Can you still recommend an AI video tool with Lifetime?

comments.author: angelarose210
comments.body: Wan2.1, framepack and others can run on as little as a 6gb gpu. Thats your only lifetime free option.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body:
Hey, thank you. I'll check.
But, if you have other Ai Video Tool for Lifetime (payment), let me know please. I would also pay money, but it should be price-performance.

comments.author: BANDOSde
comments.body:
First of all, thank you very much for your answers. This helps me a lot.

In principle, I don't mind paying money, as I've already looked at the tools mentioned above. It's just that the price-performance ratio is a bit poor.

So if you know of an AI tool specifically for video generation, please let me know. I'm willing to pay, but it should be reasonably fair.

Yes, I know ComfyUI, but then I have the "local" problem again, since I can't do anything with my phone unless I make it "online"-capable. But that's not my goal, as I don't have a powerful server, nor do I need to keep my powerful PC running all the time.

Therefore, I need an online AI tool alternative.

comments.author: sunnysogra
comments.body: I have been using [Vadoo AI](https://vadoo.tv/) for a while, and it works great based on my needs. I generate short videos and reels for my social media. You should give it a try!

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body: How satisfied are you with that? I also tested it. In my opinion, it's too much Api Key rework. If necessary, it is super option. But if you need these for everything at Vadoo Ai, it is very cumbersome.

replies.author: sunnysogra
replies.body: Actually, I’m a Pro plan user, so I don’t face this API issue. LTD users just need to add the Fal AI key to use certain features like AI videos, AI apps, AI music, and more.

replies.author: BANDOSde
replies.body: Yes. That's exactly what I need. I come to Vadoo Ai or somewhere else just for the AI ​​videos. The rest I either have in unlimited form or don't need. Therefore, even as a Pro member, I won't be without the additional API key. Annoying!

comments.author: xunil_
comments.body:
Honestly, most “lifetime deals” in AI video end up becoming limited later because GPU/video generation costs are expensive to maintain. I’d be careful buying purely based on LTD hype.

If you want something practical and stable for actual content creation, Fliki has been one of the better value tools for me. Especially for music videos, narrated visuals, lyric style content and faceless videos. Much easier workflow compared to constantly burning credits experimenting with random cinematic generators.

For pure AI cinematic generation, Runway and Kling are stronger visually, but they get expensive fast. Fliki feels more usable day to day if your goal is consistently making videos instead of just testing AI scenes.
